title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
summary: Return the k-th smallest value in a BST.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10,000 nodes with values in [0, 10,000]. The input satisfies strict BST ordering. k is between one and the node count inclusive.

statement: Return the k-th smallest value in a BST. The first smallest value has rank one.

examples.explanation: The first three values are 1, 2, and 4.
The root is the only value.
Rank three is the largest value.

constraints: 1–10,000 nodes with values in [0, 10,000]. The input satisfies strict BST ordering. k is between one and the node count inclusive.
hints: Conceptual: The left side contains the smaller values.
Directional: Visit the tree in inorder to see values in increasing order.
Implementation: Keep a stack of nodes waiting for their turn. Decrement k at each visit and stop when it reaches zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(h+k) time and O(h) auxiliary space for an inorder traversal that stops at rank k.
